# API Contract Checklist: Close the Open-Task Contract

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, parity, and failure coverage of the open-task admission requirements
**Created**: 2026-08-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all top-level, new-task, and verification-budget members identified with required/optional status? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Are resume behavior and new-task creation behavior both specified for omitted, null, and object-valued `new_task`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Are existing Core limits and closed-object rules explicitly preserved rather than replaced by host guidance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [x] CHK004 Are the three list-valued members unambiguously distinguished from scalar text fields across the spec, data model, and contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Is the verification-level vocabulary identical across functional requirements, acceptance scenarios, data model, and contract example? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 Is Core authority clearly separated from the Codex Skill's invocation-guidance responsibility? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008–FR-009]

## Acceptance and Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK007 Do the acceptance requirements cover both observed malformed inputs and the structurally valid equivalent? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 Is zero mutation objectively required for every malformed-request regression? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, SC-004]
- [x] CHK009 Are unknown members, duplicate members, wrong casing, wrong primitive types, and missing nested members addressed or explicitly bounded? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Is two-host shared-contract parity measurable without claiming unimplemented host packaging support? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, SC-001]

## Scope and Compatibility

- [x] CHK011 Are workflow, persistence, recovery, Git, tool-count, and release-state exclusions stated consistently? [Scope, Spec §FR-012, SC-005]
- [x] CHK012 Does the feature avoid requirements to accept aliases or coerce malformed input, preserving the closed contract? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
